detail.longDescription: 📅 New series: does Spectacled work with your CalDAV server? We tested popular self-hosted servers and will share the results here one by one. First up: Baïkal ✅ Journals, Notes and Tasks all worked without workarounds. ⚠️ One setting to check: Spectacled only supports HTTP Basic auth. If Baïkal is set to Digest, logins fail even with the right password. Switch it under Admin → System Settings, and serve Baïkal over HTTPS. https:// spectacled.techbee.at/server-c ompatibility/spectacled-and-baikal/ # SelfHosted # CalDAV # Baikal # FOSS
